title: Multi-Select & Bulk Delete in Packages Manager
desc: Added multi-select checkboxes, Select All toggle, and bulk delete functionality in the admin packages manager to allow administrators to remove multiple packages at once.

title: Admin Panel Layout & Scrollbar Fixes
desc: Resolved unwanted horizontal scrollbars, layout overflows, and top background color inconsistencies in the admin panel to ensure a clean, stable UI across all views.

title: Live Petrol, Diesel & LPG Price Tracking System
desc: Created complete backend and frontend architecture for daily fuel rates, including automated scraping, MySQL database schema, Prisma migrations, and public display.

title: Hot Topics Architecture & SEO URL Routing
desc: Separated Gold and Fuel into summary cards on Hot Topics and dedicated full-view pages with keyword-rich SEO URLs (/gold-rate-in-pakistan and /petrol-rate-in-pakistan).

title: Mobile Navigation Bar & Header Polish
desc: Refined responsive header navigation, improved mobile touch targets, streamlined button styling, and enhanced readability across small mobile screens.

title: Multi-Select & Batch Deletion in Fuel Manager
desc: Equipped the fuel rates admin table with row selection checkboxes, select-all controls, and batch deletion capability for efficient rate management.

title: Scraper Timezone & Real-Time Price Sync Fix
desc: Resolved date discrepancy in the gold and fuel scrapers so today's live prices match the current date accurately without stale or cached fallback values.

title: Removed Floating Green Status Badge
desc: Removed the pulsating green live status indicator from all public pages across the website while preserving accessibility screen-reader tags.

title: Route Migration from /hot to /hot-topics
desc: Renamed all Hot Stories navigation and routes to /hot-topics, updating menu links, canonical headers, and adding 301 permanent redirects for older URLs.

title: SEO Metadata Optimization for Gold, Fuel & Hot Topics
desc: Added custom SEO meta titles, descriptions, and OpenGraph social tags across Gold Rate, Fuel Price, and Hot Topics overview pages for higher search visibility.

title: CI/CD Deployment Health Check & Pipeline Fix
desc: Fixed deployment pipeline failure by enhancing curl health check retry logic and resolving build assertions in production-deploy.yml for reliable releases.

title: React Hydration Mismatch Resolution (Error #418)
desc: Eliminated React hydration errors by standardizing currency and date formatting deterministically across both server-side rendering and client hydration.

title: Newsletter Subscription Engine & Header Navigation
desc: Implemented footer newsletter subscription, database persistence, and smooth-scroll auto-focus behavior for the top header Subscribe button.

title: Dedicated Subscriber SMTP Configuration
desc: Configured isolated SiteGround SMTP settings exclusively for newsletter subscribers, leaving existing admin login and contact form credentials completely untouched.
